ideas.pitch: A pure Python web scraper using BeautifulSoup and lxml that tracks DOM mutations and layout shifts over time across e-commerce pages without using heavy headless browsers.
ideas.title: RobustHTMLDiffExtractor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since Selenium and Playwright are strictly prohibited, building a pure lxml/requests-based engine that handles dynamic DOM structures will score maximum points on scraping efficiency and edge-case handling.

ideas.pitch: An automated data profiling and integrity validation wrapper for extracted CSV/JSON scraped datasets, instantly checking cardinality, consistency, and missing values.
ideas.title: DataVeritas-Lite Scraper Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges evaluate accuracy, correctness, and processing of extracted information; automating data profiling directly targets their evaluation criteria.

ideas.pitch: A Python utility that automatically infers optimal regular expressions and CSS selector paths from raw HTML pages to extract semi-structured tabular data reliably.
ideas.title: RegexPatternAutoDiscovery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the core technical challenge of analyzing web pages and HTML structures while keeping strictly within lightweight Python constraints.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance asynchronous scraping pipeline built with httpx and asyncio featuring dynamic backoff and proxy rotation for scraping large static target lists.
ideas.title: AsyncScrapeQueue with Adaptive Rate Limiting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Scraping efficiency and edge-case handling are explicitly listed evaluation criteria; an async implementation demonstrates superior software development capability.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local vector-embedding search engine over scraped text chunks using compact transformer embeddings to find specific facts across extracted web data.
ideas.title: LocalSemanticScraperQuery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust data extraction with advanced post-processing of extracted information, satisfying the processing and problem-solving approach criteria.
